description: Gatton Sky Image and PV Generation 2020 is a data set deposited in uq.repo by its authors Shijie Xu, Hui Ma (The University of Queensland). The data regarding PV generation and sky images were acquired from a solar farm situated at The University of Queensland's Gatton campus in Australia, possessing a peak capacity of 3.275 MW. Two MOBITIX hemispheric cameras (Q25) have been installed to take real-time images of the sky above the solar farm. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is UQ General Usage Terms and Conditions for data publishing in eSpace. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
